_about: Hand-labeled answers for sample_rule.md against controls.json. gap: none = an existing control covers it, partial = a control exists but falls short, full = nothing covers it. Sections 1 and 16 hold no obligation.

obligations.why: Inventory is reconciled quarterly; the rule wants updates within 30 days.
Due diligence does not cover training practices.
No control defines human review thresholds or override.
Escalation is within five business days; the rule wants 72 hours.
Marketing and UDAAP reviews do not check generated content before delivery.
The risk appetite statement does not cover AI.
Annual training does not cover AI tool limitations.
